analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 11 Nov 2026
key_insights: Institutional activity was quieter because of the bond market holiday, but there was a clear re-risk back into semis and levered-AI names.
Retail is driving tape volume: three stocks (all under $1, '4c') made up 32% of overall tape volumes. GS Retail Favs basket (GSXURFAV) is +6.46, its second best day in the last 3 years.
Neocloud strength is helping drive a rotation back into Tech. GS CTA math says the follow-through has fuel, with meaningful demand in an up-tape over the next 1 week and 1 month.
Semis are 17% better to buy across the GS platform, with hedge funds driving much of the skew and long-only accounts also adding. SOX is approaching its 200-day moving average at 10,865.
NVDA is down 540bps since Monday while SOX is up 14% over the same period.
Hyperscalers lagged the broader re-risk and are being used as a source of funds. NVDA is trying to recover part of the $430B of market cap lost this week.
GS floor activity is down 20% vs the trailing two weeks, but market volumes are up 13% vs the 10-day moving average.
GS floor flow is 13% better to buy, driven by hedge funds. Hedge funds are +18% with large buy skews in Tech and Cons Disc.
Long-only accounts are slightly better to buy overall. They are selling Tech and Cons Disc to buy Healthcare, Comm Services and Industrials.
Chart of the day: 12-month momentum (GSPRHIMO) has its biggest outperformance vs shorter-term momentum on record, with both 3-month (GSPRHMO3) and 6-month (GSPRHMO6) momentum baskets lagging.
